name: Workspace Superpowers
description: Portable workflows for documents, research, citations, spreadsheets, presentations, and verified deliverables. Local dogfooding build.
safetyNotes: Skill catalog and native agent prompt bootstrap only. Activated multi-stage checklists use the host's built-in TodoWrite tool and chat UI. This plugin does not intercept TodoWrite, register a checklist tool or command, open a panel, or read session state through the plugin SDK. Portable approval, blocker, cancellation and reopening rules remain in conversation context; no separate checklist database, file writes, credentials or network requests are used. Tool success and visible progress do not authorize drafting or prove live acceptance.
